mission.title: Springing the Jaws
mission.description: Use Zion's kill codes to break through the Effectuator's guards and bug him.

npc.say: I am prepared to assist you in defending against this ambush, {player}. Otherwise, I will remain here to guard the Zion operative.
The codes are in hand, and the Exile attackers have been dealt with.

phase.briefing:
A new tactic has presented itself in the hunt for the Effectuator. Zion operatives have offered their help. Apparently they have access to some advanced kill codes, capable of dealing with the particular Exiles that protect your target.
Some of our Agents have met with their operative, known as Alekto. Go to the warehouse indicated and obtain the codes from her. It would seem that they want nothing in return, other than our continuing aggression against the Merovingian. Something that is... easy enough to agree with.

enter.say: Alekto is in here somewhere. You can get the kill codes from her.

objective.text: Get the kill codes from Alekto

talk.say:
{player}! Finally, a real person to talk to... uh, no offense, Agent Clark...
I've got the codes for you. Trust me, they'll do the trick against those dark wolves.

done.say: Nice, now you just need to get those to a hardline and-- Wait! I'm reading inbound hostile signals! Take them out, {player}!

objective.text: Upload the kill codes at a hardline

phase.briefing: Machine scientists are examining the codes you uploaded. Proceed to our laboratory. Dr. Valvo will have the results ready for you.

enter.say: Dr Valvo is here. I wonder if we'll be able to use those codes Zion gave us?

talk.say:
A pleasure to meet you, {player}. Your efforts for the cause of the Machines have b--
Oh. Pardon me. You want the results of our research. I tend to get distracted and ramble when interacting with h--
My apologies. If you will, ah, lead me to my workstation, I will supply you with the results.

objective.text: Lead Dr. Valvo to his workstation

done.say: So, is your ear still attached? I never thought he'd finish.

phase.briefing:
Everything is in place, {player}.
Proceed to the location indicated. The Effectuator has been there recently; even if he has left, we should be able to track his current coordinates.

enter.say: I don't know if he's still in there or not, but there are still some Exiles on site. Your only goal here is to pick up readings on the target, not mindless slaughter.

objective.text: Pick up readings on the Effectuator

done.say: Bingo. The fluctuations are still readable, and... we've got our coordinates. You can get out of there now.

phase.briefing:
The Effectuator is at the coordinates listed. Proceed there, destroy the Exiles guarding him, and place the bug on the Effectuator's projection.
The kill code device should enable you to bypass his guards before he has a chance to escape.

enter.say: The fluctuations are starting up. Get in there now!

Everything checks out... loads of Exiles, the Effectuator. He hasn't started going anywhere. Now's your chance!
Once you've been in there for a bit, the kill code device should start locking onto those Exiles.

objective.text: Kill the Exiles guarding the Effectuator

done.say: There goes the kill code device! Keep going through the far door, as fast as you can!

objective.text: Place the bug on the Effectuator

talk.say:
You're pathetic, {player}. You come in here, thinking you can actually hurt me? Not likely.
Time to wish me bon voyage, you moron!
Now! Put the bug on him!

done.say:
I gotta admit, I thought this was going to be another disappointment. Very nice work!
Oh and by the way, make sure you have some inventory slots available. I think Gray is going to download something once you're out.

complete.say: The area is under control. The target individual is in our custody.

mission.finish:
Your performance here today has been outstanding, {player}. With the Effectuator in our custody, we have most certainly weakened the Merovingian's grasp on his crumbling organization.
Our scientists have created some copies of the enhanced kill code data. One of our Machine Investigators can compile the data into fully functional kill codes. These will provide assistance in the continuing fight against the Merovingian.
